<!-- nativecmpkit-io010-direct-20261028 -->
### Resolved after important tests and direct source/results review

All **five original criteria** are accepted; closing directly, without waiting for unrelated full-suite/release gates.

- **Fresh Linux JVM 3/3 + Android-host 1/1:** immutable `f8d968a2b95ccaa97f65ac5d2e85cbe21e17f35d`, two fresh XML, zero failures/errors/skips, Gradle exit 0/57.01 s. All 800 own-Git inputs held; actual JDK17. Genuine filesystem regular/directory/file-link/directory-link/broken-link cases and both overloads pass. Registered real AndroidX/resolver controlled query/MIME denials return truthful false/null and never open a stream; this is not OS grant-denial enforcement.
- **Recovered only the failed Android native method, 1/1:** [40736698391](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40736698391), immutable `72afd94da564b3020fea2fdd44eb6beb6b1ba403`. Actual API35 enforcing emulator/FileProvider verifies size64, rejects bound63 before any stream/descriptor; one fresh XML, exit0/60.02 s, 798 own-Git inputs/JDK17 held, successful actual APK setup and clean unforced emulator exit0. Whole workflow success. The earlier device00416/17 failure stays archived; its exact root cause is **not proven from MIME-column warnings**.
- **Reuse, not new executions:** the unchanged real JS/Wasm four-filename/parity method (2 original executions) from browser004, and five actual iOS missing/ordinary/directory/non-file-URL methods from [40687472609](https://github.com/Apdelrahman1911/nativeCmpkit/actions/runs/40687472609), immutable `e844e4b0`. Exact owning sources match; browser sanitized XML is matched through its original receipt/archive rather than falsely equated to the raw XML hash. Browser004 was held dirty source, not an immutable release candidate. No successful unrelated suite rerun.

**Acceptance:** README/LICENSE/dotfile/dotted browser files; missing desktop/iOS references; actual directories/regular files/symbolic links; controlled permission-denied metadata; context/context-free parity. **12 reviewed target-method executions: 5 fresh + 7 reused**, not 12 newly authored tests or a full platform suite.

Owning repairs retain public APIs/packages: browser File objects are never directories inferred from a dot; `isFile` means an existing non-directory snapshot. It is **not** a regular-inode, access-grant, atomic-metadata or symlink-rejection certificate; real JVM links follow targets and broken aliases are missing. Previously permissive missing-file behavior intentionally becomes false. Android openable MIME classification uses the provider's supported MIME API; original host red/green evidence remains.

Broader Apple/Windows symlink, real OS-ACL/grant/physical-device/minimum-platform, heap/ABI/consumer/dependency/legal/security/CI/release gates remain separate. No publication/deployment or gate waiver.

Evidence: `docs/development/evidence/io-kind-important-direct-20261028/`; original finding/issue history is retained.
